text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити shares her thoughts with me,
realizing
all her choices have been
driven by the
expectations of those
around her—whether trying
to meet
them or to rebel against them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She says she wasn't making decisions on
her own,
that it's because she's an empty
doll that she has
no answer to the
question of why she runs.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I reassure her that it won't be the end of
the world
if she decides to stop running.
But even then, she
can't bring herself to
say she'll quit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I urge her to run to her heart's content.
With all
her strength, she dashes around
the track, her
whole heart and mind
thrust into each stЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even if it's painful, even when it's tough,
the
reason she runs is without a doubt
because she
wants to.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
